label: Madder Root
colourWords: dried madder root, reddish-brown or dark brown outside, from a standard for Rubia cordifolia. S4 names rubia tinctoria among historic sources of red, so the species differs and the hex is inferred.
renderNote: Photo: three cut pieces labelled Indian Madder, Rubia cordifolia, Bombay, a museum lot of unstated age, the middle value of the pieces, a raw reading not calibrated to the chart in the frame. S4 names rubia tinctoria among historic sources of red, so the species this craft holds stays open; a R. tinctorum bundle from Georgia reads grey-brown #6A523F, and other Indian lots read from #724429 to #995136. Camera value under that photo's own light, not albedo. A photo of this material elsewhere is not evidence of what the workshop holds, so the row stays flagged for the lead.
